title: Lafayette, LA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lafayette, LA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lafayette is a city in LA with a population of 125,000. Heart of Cajun and Creole country with vibrant music, food, and festival culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
